works.dialog_same_vin_body:
VIN {vin} already belongs to {car} (owner: {owner}).

Is it the same car with a new plate {number}?

Yes — same car: its plate will change, the job history stays
No — go back and check the VIN
works.dialog_same_vin_owner_body:
VIN {vin} already belongs to {car} (owner: {old}).

The record now says: plate {number}, client {new}.
Looks like the car was sold and re-registered. Is this a new owner?

Yes — same car, new owner: the plate changes to {number}, the car and its whole job history pass to {new_name}
No — same car, same owner: the plate changes, {old_name}'s name / phone are updated
Cancel — go back and check the VIN
works.dialog_new_owner_body:
Car {number} is registered to: {old}.

The record now says: {new}. Is this a new owner?

Yes — new owner: the car and its whole job history pass to them ({old_name} will no longer have it)
No — same person: rewrite {old_name}'s client card — the new name / phone will apply to all their cars (cars of this client: {cars})
Cancel — back to the record
works.dialog_new_owner_only_body:
Car {number} is registered to: {old}.

The record now says: {new} — a different name and phone, so this is a different person.

OK — new owner: the car and its whole job history pass to them ({old_name} will no longer have it)
Cancel — back to the record

If {old_name} actually changed both name and phone, edit them in the client card.
works.dialog_phone_taken_body:
Car {number} is registered to: {old}.

Phone {phone} already belongs to another client: {other}.

OK — the car and its whole job history pass to {other}
Cancel — back to the record to check the phone
works.msg_phone_taken:

Check the phone or choose "Yes — new owner".
works.dialog_rename_body:

The record now has the name: {new}.

No — a different person: enter their phone
Cancel — back to the record

backup.title: Backup
backup.description:
The app automatically creates a .zip archive with the database and settings once a day into a "Backup" folder next to the program — this works out of the box, no setup needed.

To also get a copy in the cloud: download and install the Google Drive desktop app from Google's official website, sign in to your Google account, then below select the folder Google Drive syncs on this computer (or the equivalent Yandex.Disk folder) — the app will place the same copy there too.
